translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content: Blz Angidr Nangi Nzawi-ngrbz Mz Gct

content.text: Yawe, nide Gct kc tqxplr esz'ngr.
X zluli rde pnamilxtile mzteadau Jerusalem kc tqlqngi.
A' nrlc ycngrlrlzm mz nzvz-krmle,
Murde nyr wounepx kai mz nzangc-krde da amrlx,
X nounenq o-ngalelvzle nide.
X kqlele lr Heven mz nzayrlwr-lxblr-krdr leplz amrlx mz nrlc.
Navzmqng mz nzmc-krdr nztubqkr natqde,
Mz nzpipx-krde nzvz-rbrkr leplz nedeng.
X rpibzle mz lr Heven kx, “Vzmimamu krkcng tzlxngitilr ninge,
X drtwrgr badr tqesz'ti mz nzangc-krmlr bange blz krdr, murde nayrlwr-ngalelvzlr ninge.”
X lr Heven nzrpilr kx, “Gct, nzaclve-krm rsakrlrngr.
Murde tubqq mz nzryrlq-krm drtwr.”
Rpi Gct kx, “Leplz nengeng, xlrmamu natqnge.
Murde ninge Gct rmu x na-aelwa-ngrbo mrkc tqvz-rbrtiamu.
Animol kc tqngi blz tqkamamu bange, trngiu da kx myapxbz,
Mz nzangco-zvz-krmamuleng mz olta.
X trngi-kzu da kx myapxbz nzangc-krmamu bange
Gout x kzu kxncblongr dalr nardzng nyzmu.
Murde dalr peto amrlx nyzngeng,
X wai-kzle kzu amrlx kcng tzmncng mz siu r newz.
Utc ngr peto amrlx nengeng,
Nidr badr animol ngr nardzng.
Nzmu nabrtalex x drtwrnge brlxkz tr-rlxpwc'u bamu da.
Murde nrlc nyznge x dalrdeng amrlx.
X trmuwxu ncvr kzu.
X tr-rmnqwxu mepyr ngr gout.
A' blz angidr nangi nzawi-krmamu bange,
X nzangidati-krmu da kx esalz-ngrmamu bange.
X mrlz nzkrka'-krmamu bange mzli kc tqkxpu-ngrnamu,
Murde naglqlzamu ninge kalr mz nzarlapx-krnge nimu.”
A' rpibz Gct mz leplz kxdrka'-ngrng kx, “Trtakitrdeu nzyapwxti-zvz-krmu Loukxtr scnge,
Mz nzycmnetr-krmu Nzryrngrkxtrng.
Murde pxtxpx-ngrnamu nzatubqti-krnge nimu,
X rtctx-ngrnamu natqnge.
Alwx ngrmung nidr seleng:
Mrlzbz bamu nzngi-kzte-krmu ncblo kx pna da,
X nzprtr-ngrbz mz leplz kcng tzrmwimi-abeaneng leplz kx trngiu krnalzdr.
Ycmnetrpwzmu mz da kxtrka,
X naomu tresakiu nzrpi-twzti-krdr da kx nzesabrtingr.
Pikiti-zvzamu kztemung,
X pibqti-kzamu mzlemung.
Mz nzale-krmu da lcng sc tqmnc-lrpinebo.
X rpiamu mz drtwrmu, mrlzm bange nzale-krmuleng.
A' trtingr! Murde da kcng tqvz-rbrtiamu delcng tqaplxtipx-atebo bamu.
“Mzli ka natekqtramu nqmq krmu,
Murde ma tqodatitxne nimu
X sc trpengr kx na-arlapxle nimu.
X bzkq mrbrtr mz drtwrmu nzamatq-krmu ninge.
Blz angidr nangi nzawi-krmamu bange.
Murde narmctiamu nzarlapx-krnge nimu, mz nzvz-nqblq-krmu ninge.”
